notes: Paired studies run baseline then candidate in each of three sequential pairs. Compilation, tests, and reviewer differential runs do not overlap timings.
Each process uses seven calibrated batches after warmup; baseline and candidate executables have identical benchmark adapters.
Source-only test commits between measured production revisions do not change the binaries. All results include output disposal.
GFM is not equal-output: Inkmark omits www.example.com autolinking and serializes tables differently.
Allocation calls exclude reallocations, input loading, and options construction. Requested bytes include growth and are not retained or peak memory.

The final same-source comparison was repeated once after an unchanged binary varied from roughly 5.1 to 4.2 ms on mixed 1 MB. Both complete runs and all six pairs are retained; background macOS media analysis and indexing were active during portions of the first run.

No project builds, tests, or reviewer differential runs overlap timings; ordinary unrelated machine processes are not controlled. Final engine pairs alternate order; earlier optimization studies run baseline then candidate.
Focused scanner fixtures time complete Markdown-to-HTML conversion, not just the byte scanner.
The final six-engine report is a snapshot; use the retained pairs and first run to assess variability.

final_runs.first-run-*.jsonl: First sequential six-engine run; retained in full.
final_runs.paired-first-*.jsonl: Three pairs after first run, alternating core/Inkmark order.
final_runs.*-commonmark.jsonl and *-gfm.jsonl: Unprefixed six-engine files are the repeated sequential run. Diagnostic core-prepare, core-events, core-arena and allocations were measured after the first run.
final_runs.paired-final-*.jsonl: Three pairs after repeated run, alternating core/Inkmark order.
final_runs.final-scanners-*.jsonl and final-referen: Complete HTML timings on supplemental fixtures after first run.
final_runs.repeat-validation-*.jsonl: Diagnostic repeat with saved d361f6e baseline binary and unchanged final binary; old baseline uses pre-c62db79 harness. This checks variation, not an isolated new source optimization.
